Frequently Asked Questions About Mini Split Service in Washington

A mini split heat pump provides both cooling and heating. In summer, it extracts heat from your home and moves it outside. In winter, it reverses the process, extracting heat from the outdoor air in Washington and bringing it inside.

Yes! Modern heat pump mini splits work efficiently down to -13Â°F (-25Â°C). However, extremely cold winters in Washington can reduce efficiency. If your mini split struggles in cold weather, we can inspect the defrost cycle and refrigerant charge.

We recommend mini split cleaning every 6â€“12 months in Washington. If you run your system heavily or have pets/allergies, quarterly cleanings are ideal. Regular cleaning improves efficiency, air quality, and extends system life by 3â€“5 years.
